texts.facts: This review application has been filed for review of the order dated 26.09.2012 passed in CWJC No.9242 of 2012. The writ application was filed challenging the cancellation of licences of the petitioners for running meat shop. The reason assigned in the order was that the meat shops were running in unhygienic condition with a bad upkeep causing danger to the health of the consumers. This Court noticed the stand of the petitioners that they were ready to improve conditions of their shops to conform the requirements of law. Thus, enough liberty was granted by this Court to the respondents to refuse renewal of the lincences of the petitioners, if they found that the same was in violation of any law or causing any problem to the administration.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the review petitioner has referred to a joint report of the S.D.O and S.D.P.O. dated 13.10.2012, as contained in Annexure-8, and the letter of the Collector to the Civil Surgeon dated 14.10.2012, as contained in Annexure-8/1. He submits that apart from unhygienic condition, all the writ petitioners were violating the provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2011 also. He submits that, as per the report, the running of the shops in thickly populated residential area was becoming a law and order problem for the administration.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the review petitioner has referred to a joint report of the S.D.O and S.D.P.O. dated 13.10.2012, as contained in Annexure-8, and the letter of the Collector to the Civil Surgeon dated 14.10.2012, as contained in Annexure-8/1. He submits that apart from unhygienic condition, all the writ petitioners were violating the provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2011 also. He submits that, as per the report, the running of the shops in thickly populated residential area was becoming a law and order problem for the administration.
